about.title: About Me
about.intro: I’m a Full Stack JavaScript Developer with 5 years of practical, project-driven experience (since 2021). On the backend, I build high-throughput APIs using Fastify, relational data schemas with PostgreSQL and Drizzle ORM, and granular access control (RBAC/ABAC) using CASL. On the frontend, I apply the BFF (Backend-for-Frontend) pattern using Next.js App Router to deliver ultra-fast, real-time web products.
bullets: High-performance backend development with Fastify, Node.js, and modular plugin architectures
Type-safe relational database design with PostgreSQL and modern Drizzle ORM & Prisma
Fine-grained authorization & permissions (RBAC/ABAC) using CASL across backend and frontend
Frontend architecture leveraging the BFF (Backend-for-Frontend) pattern with Next.js App Router & SSR
Production experience building real-time event-driven workflows with Socket.IO and SSE
Strong commitment to Web Performance, Accessibility, and clean, maintainable codebases
